types: MIL-F-18327, Discrete LC and Crystal Components (Composition 2)

notes: This is the handbook default model for non-tunable electronic filters, to be used when the component level failure rates that make up the filter are not known. The ceramic-ferrite row covers MIL-F-15733 styles FL 10-16, 22, 24, 30-32, 34, 35, 38, 41-43, 45, 47-50, 61-65, 70, 81-93, 95 and 96; the discrete LC row for MIL-F-15733 covers styles FL 37, 53 and 74. Section 21 was not revised by Notice 2, so this is the base handbook page 21-1 as retained in the Notice 2 handbook. In the task section list this category was called 20.x; in the handbook as published it is Section 21.
